thread:
Alina: quick alignment  we need three crisp competitive claims for the launch week assets (blog, webinar, battlecard). audience: infra/platform buyers + SEs. keep each claim one short line and include two short rebut bullets.

Sam: propose pillars: 1) predictable unit economics for production, 2) dependable tail latency with fallback policies, 3) one runtime across hosted/dedicated/private.

Tor: agree. sales needs two-line rebut per claim. quick drafts: 
- Predictable econ rebut: 'Redwood stabilizes per-request cost so finance can forecast without heavy overprovisioning.' 
- Tail latency rebut: 'Automatic fallback to quantized variants or regional routing preserves responsiveness under spikes.' 
- Runtime rebut: 'Same API and tooling across deployments 1 no rewrite when you migrate.'

Priya: promo A/B ideas: 
A: 'Predictable cost. Dependable performance.' 
B: 'One API from prototype to SLA-ready serving.'
short subheads: 'Budget certainty for inference' vs 'Ship reliable LLM features fast.'

Maya: benchmark guidance: show p50/p95/p99 latency + cost per 1M tokens. include tiny methodology line: `Method: 7k anonymized prompts, median 120 tokens. Measured p50/p95/p99 and normalized token cost; compared hosted endpoints and a tuned dedicated instance.` Avoid absolutes like "cheapest".

Alina: Ops asks for a single failure-modes slide: flow = quantized fallback -> regional reroute -> queued backpressure. keeps answers for "what if capacity spikes" simple for sales.

Sam: short battlecard rebut soundbites: 
- "We run infra": 'You keep control but remove day-to-day ops & get predictable economics at scale.' 
- "API is enough": 'We keep simple APIs while adding production observability and private deployments.' 
- "Cloud scale": 'We match region routing + offer dedicated placements for compliance and SLAs.'

Priya: dropping a one-line beta quote for the deck: 'Moving to Dedicated let us forecast inference spend for the quarter.'

Alina: action list: 
 Alina  draft 2 headline variants + 90s webinar opener (today)
 Sam  run 48h SE poll + collect 3 rebut examples (48h)
 Tor  produce benchmark chart mock + methodology blurb (tomorrow)
 Priya  finalize promo copy + social snippets (EOD)
 Maya  own failure-modes slide + legal-safe phrasing (tomorrow)

ops-bot: doc created: https://notion.redwood/competitive/claimcraft-v1 (v1) :white_check_mark:

Sam: I'll ping when poll results are in. drop any customer soundbites backing econ here. :thumbsup:

Priya: added a short customer soundbite: 'Dedicated gave us stable per-request costs and predictable monthly spend.'

Alina: great. keep the copy testable and avoid superlatives. we'll iterate after Sam and Tor deliverables. :rocket:
